## When you'd use this

<UseCases>
<UseCase title="A follow-up on Yes">
Ask for the therapist's name only when the answer to "Does the client currently see a therapist?" is Yes.
</UseCase>
<UseCase title="A section for some respondents">
Show a group of questions about medication only when "Do you take any medication?" is answered Yes.
</UseCase>
<UseCase title="An age threshold">
Show a "Parent or guardian" group only when the client's age, a Number question, is less than 18.
</UseCase>
</UseCases>

See the first one working in the [follow-up question example](/docs/examples/follow-up-question).

## Before you start

- The question the condition reads, its **source**, must come **before** the question, group or page you are making conditional, in reading order. Add or move it there first.
- The source must be a question whose answer can be compared. These can be sources: Short answer, Multiple choice, Checkboxes, Dropdown, Multi-select, Number, Email, Phone number, Link, Date, Time, Linear scale, Rating, Ranking and Respondent's country.
- These can't: Long answer, Matrix, Grid, groups, pages, and the blocks that collect no answer (Heading, Text, Divider, Title, Label, Image, Video and Audio).

## Steps

1. Select the question, group or page to show only sometimes. Its settings open.
2. Under **Logic**, in **Show this question only when…**, select **Add condition**. The new condition reads the nearest question before it, with is answered.
<Gif alt="Adding a first condition in the Logic section" />
3. In the condition's first box, choose the source. The list has only the questions you can use, numbered as on the canvas and grouped under the groups they are in.
4. In the second box, choose how to compare. What it offers depends on the source:

| Source | Operators |
|---|---|
| Multiple choice, Dropdown, Respondent's country, Short answer, Email, Phone number, Link, Date, Time | is answered, is, is not |
| Number, Linear scale, Rating | is answered, is, is not, is greater than, is less than, is at least, is at most |
| Checkboxes, Multi-select, Ranking | is answered, includes |

5. Unless you chose is answered, give the answer to compare with. For a source with options you choose an option by its label, and the builder stores its code. For Number, Linear scale and Rating you type a number. For the others you type the text.
6. For a second condition, select **Add condition** again. A **Logic** field appears, filled in with `1 AND 2`.
7. Say how the conditions combine, using their numbers, AND, OR and brackets:
   - All of them: `1 AND 2 AND 3`
   - Any of them: `1 OR 2 OR 3`
   - Your own mix: `1 OR (2 AND 3)`
<Gif alt="Typing custom logic in the Logic field" />
8. Select **Save**.

<Note>
There is no NOT. To show a question when an answer is not Yes, use the is not operator in the condition itself.
</Note>

<Note>
Conditions can't be reordered. If you delete one, every higher number in the Logic field goes down by one, so `1 OR 3` becomes `1 OR 2`.
</Note>

<Note>
The first page of a form can't have conditions: it is always shown.
</Note>

## What happens behind the scenes

- **An item shows only when its own conditions pass and every group or page around it is showing.**
- **A hidden source fails only its own condition.** With `1 OR 2`, a hidden source for condition 1 still lets condition 2 show the question.
- **Every operator except is answered needs an answer.** Until the source is answered, is not Yes, is less than 18 and the rest are all false.
- **Answers to hidden questions are kept while the form is being filled in.** If the respondent changes their mind and the question shows again, their answer is still there. With Save progress "Only while the form is open", a page refresh loses them. "On this device" and "On the app's server" keep them.
- **They are never submitted and never checked.** A hidden required question doesn't stop the form being submitted, and the browser leaves its answer out of the payload.
- **Your server drops them too.** `prepareSubmission` returns answers to visible questions only. An answer to a hidden question in the body is removed, never a reason to reject it.
- **The downloaded file carries the logic as a tree**, so the renderer never reads your text. A single condition, or all AND, is just `enableWhen`. All OR adds `enableBehavior: "any"`. A mix adds `enableLogic`, the tree.

## Rules the builder enforces

The builder refuses any change that would leave a condition pointing at something it can't use, and says which blocks are in the way, each with a link:

| What you try | What the builder says |
|---|---|
| Delete a question that conditions use | Can't delete "Smoker" — these questions have conditions that depend on it: |
| Delete a group and its questions, when a question outside it has a condition on one inside | Can't delete "Medication" and its questions — these questions outside it have conditions that depend on something inside it: |
| Delete a page and its contents, in the same case | Can't delete "History" and its contents — these questions outside it have conditions that depend on something inside it: |
| Move or insert something so a question would come before its source: dragging, Move to, moving a page up or down, or deleting a page and keeping its contents | Can't move "Smoker" there — these questions would end up before a question their conditions depend on: (the start names what you tried, for example Can't move "History" up, or Can't insert "Vitals" there) |
| Move a page with conditions so it becomes the first page | Can't move "History" up: "History" would become the first page, and the first page can't have conditions — it is always shown. Remove the conditions on "History" first. |
| Move something so a condition would read a question inside a repeating group the dependent isn't in | Can't move "Dose" there — these blocks would have conditions on a question inside a repeating group they aren't in: |
| Turn on Repeats for a group, when a question outside it has a condition on one inside | Can't make "Medication" repeat — these blocks outside it have conditions that use a question inside it: |
| Change the type of a question that conditions use | Can't change the type of "Smoker" — these questions have conditions that depend on it: |
| Remove an option that a condition uses | Can't remove "Former smoker" — these blocks have conditions that use it: |
| Replace a list from a file that leaves out a code a condition uses | Can't replace the options — these blocks have conditions that use a code that isn't in the file: |
| Delete a condition whose number is in the Logic field | Condition 2 is used in the logic. Remove it from the logic first. |

The names in quotation marks are examples; the builder uses yours.

<Tip>
Changing an option's code isn't refused: every condition that uses the old code moves to the new one, and the builder says how many, for example "2 conditions updated to use "former"."
</Tip>

## Troubleshooting

**Add condition isn't there.** No question before this one can be a source. The panel says "Only questions before this question can be used. Add or move a question before it first."

**A question you expected isn't in the source list.** It comes after this one, it is a type that can't be a source, or it is inside a repeating group this block isn't in. In the last case the panel says "Some questions aren't listed because they're inside a repeating group this block isn't in."

**The Logic field shows a message.** It is checked after you stop typing, and only the first problem is shown. For example "Add brackets to show whether AND or OR comes first." for `1 AND 2 OR 3`, or "Condition 3 isn't used." after you add a third condition. The form can't be saved until it's fixed.

**The question never shows.** Check that the source is answered, and showing, when you test it. Check also every group or page around the question: each must be showing too.
